value.rationale: Host-edge recovery from a single bit per vertex per paired trial is a substantial coarsening of graph or degree observations. The positive-support theorem is an all-host structural identification law, and the explicit polynomial-sample decoder is quantitatively meaningful for noisy repeat experiments; not merely routine enumeration or renamed raw-degree covariance.
